title: Transcript invariance under an unqueried coordinate
statement:
Let $n,r$ be nonnegative integers, let $T$ be a nonadaptive tester of Boolean strings of length $n$ using $r$ query positions, let $s$ be a seed of $T$, and let $i
e j$ be an arbitrary coordinate in $\{0,\dots,n-1\}$. If none of the query positions for seed $s$ addresses coordinate $i$, then the transcript obtained by querying the string that is true only at $i$ equals the transcript obtained by querying the constantly false string.
